recipes.name: Salsa Mac and Beef
ingredients_raw: 1 (10.75 ounce) can Campbell's® Condensed Cheddar Cheese Soup

steps.text: Cook the beef in a 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat until it's well browned, stirring to separate meat. Pour off any fat.
Stir the stock in the skillet and heat to a boil. Stir in the pasta. Reduce the heat to medium. Cook for 10 minutes or until the pasta is tender, stirring often.
Stir in the soup and salsa and cook until the mixture is hot and bubbling, stirring often.

raw_recipe.headline: Salsa Mac and Beef
raw_recipe.description: This one-pot supper sports big flavors. Sauteed ground beef is stirred into shell pasta with a cheesy sauce and Pace® Chunky Salsa. Garnish with chopped cilantro, if desired.

review.reviewBody: I made a few changes to this recipe, and it turned out amazing! First I browned the ground beef with half an onion (large). I also used 2 cloves of garlic and 1 tsp cajun spice, and salt and pepper to taste. I also added about 3/4 cup grated sharpe Cheddar cheese and sour cream as topping and 2 diced green onions. Amazing!

This turned out amazing! It was a great base recipe and I gave it four stars because I made modifications. I cooked the beef with a small chopped onion and added 1 pack taco seasoning as others had suggested. I used a low sodium organic beef broth and did need to add more to fully cook the noodles. I'd say just watch the noodles and add more if you feel it's needed. Then to cut back on sodium and other not so nice ingredients, I used a queso cheese dip instead of the condensed soup. It was amazingly rich and flavorful. The queso added a "kick" to it. Super easy and fast to make and the boyfriend couldn't get enough of it!

I made my version with chicken instead of beef. I felt like it needed more liquid to cook the noodles so I added 2 cups of hot water and then once the noodles cooked I strained some out. Also, 1/2 cup salsa might not be enough. It's not a strong flavor. In the future I will add a bag of the Mexican Style cheese that has spices blended in to give it more spice and flavor. Overall though, very happy with this quick, kid friendly meal!
I switched out the cheddar soup for a jar of old El Paso queso cheese. It was a flavour bomb.

I made a few changes, such as adding cumin, chili powder, and garlic. I also used rotes instead of salsa. I added shredded cheddar and jack cheese at the end. All in all, very flavorful. Not bad for a quick meal.

This was quick and easy. It had a good taste, but I also added onion and garlic to the meat, and cayenne and cilantro to the final mixture. I will definitely make again, next time with a spicier kick. Thanks for the recipe!

alright as is, but i added as some other users suggested one onion and 2 cloves of garlic to the sauteeing beef. i also added 1 tbsp of chili powder, 1/2 tsp garlic salt and a few shakes of hot sauce. my sauce was a bit runny but that could have been my fault so i added a bit of corn startch mixed in cold water. yummy dinner!

Made this tonight and hubby and son in law loved it! And my 12 year old granddaughter said it was delicious and asked for seconds. The only change I made was I had to make my own cheese sauce because I didn't have the soup. However, I set out salsa, dot cream, and cheese so everyone could put more to their liking. Quick and easy and a keeer!
My family likes a little more of a kick in their food, so I add a cup of salsa and it did the trick, very easy and quick meal. Will be adding to my recipe box.

OK, so it's basically home-made Hamburger Helper, but sometimes, with kids.... that's not a bad thing! My 13 year old loved this. I followed other reviewers' recommendations to add garlic and onion (and just used pre-minced out of a jar for both, added in with the broth). I had to use beef bouillion as I was out of the boxed broth. I started out with 2 cups of shell macaroni, and used 2 1/2 cups of broth which was NOT enough. When the water was almost completely boiled out, I tested a piece of the pasta and it was nowhere near done enough. I probably added at least another cup of water and continued boiling. I also added more salsa than called for, and used Fiesta Cheddar Cheese soup, as it was all I had on hand.

My family and I really enjoyed this meal it was quick and easy. I did sautee the onions as well and added some chili powder and garlic powder. My daughter is very sensitive to spicy food so I also mixed some sour cream after it was cooked and she loved it.
This is absolutely delicious I’m always having requests to make more of it.
So good! Add onions, peppers and 2 tbsp cheese whiz. Change to 2.5 cups beef broth, 2 cups pasta, 1 cup of salsa.
My whole family loved it it fed a total of 7people. My little cousin loved it and ate every bite of it. Great recipe and very cheap to make.
I didn’t enjoy this one. The canned cheese was really gross. The kids ate it, but I’ll likely not make this again. I’d prefer the boxed version. Or a way to use real cheese.
Yummy comfort food! And so easy to make! I added some onions, a little garlic and some spices with the hamburger. This is a keeper.
